description.value: Mariner Pizza is a family-owned and operated pizzeria that has been serving the Sidney and North Saanich communities for over 20 years. The kitchen makes fresh dough daily and a signature homemade pizza sauce, and the restaurant caters to large group orders for events, schools, and sports clubs with 24–48 hours notice. Touring cyclists can order takeout for pickup or have pizza delivered anywhere in the Sidney and North Saanich areas.

address.value: 2321 James White Blvd, Sidney, BC V8L 3Y2

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is fully accessible and confirms the OSM address (2321 James White Blvd, Sidney, BC V8L 3Y2) and phone (250-656-9606), establishing the business as a real, operating pizza restaurant. The order page explicitly offers 'Takeout Pickup at the restaurant' and the menu page states 'Now offering Gluten Free Crust.' No mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or other cyclist-specific amenities appears anywhere on the site.
concerns: Website is hosted on a third-party platform (brygid.online) rather than a dedicated domain; the COVID-19 safety notice suggests some content may be dated, though the ©2024 footer indicates the site has been maintained recently.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating local pizzeria with an active website, confirmed address and phone, and clear takeout service — straightforwardly useful to a touring cyclist seeking a meal.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Website states 'Now offering Gluten Free Crust' on the menu page
